notes.title: Development Update January 2023
notes.content:
It's been an exciting few months for the Rifters team, and we've made a lot of progress on new cards, a battle board inspired by the Zunson Race, and more. We can't wait to share our updates with the community!

[list]
[*] We are introducing new cards that players have been asking for. These cards will add new strategies and gameplay options to the game for each of the races in the rift.
[*] We were rebalancing existing cards to create a more enjoyable gameplay experience. This includes adjusting the DK points or abilities of certain cards that help to counter overpowered strategies.
[*] We were implementing new features to improve the overall player experience. A new tutorial system to help new players get up to speed, or improvements to the matchmaking system to ensure that players are matched with opponents of a similar skill level.
[/list]

Additionally, We're excited to announce that we'll be taking part in the next Steam fest. Stay tuned for more details about what we have for this special event. We can't wait to see you there!"
